item.title: The Quantum Kid: Peter Shor, Steven Chu & John Preskill Explain Quantum – So You Can Finally Understand It
item.summary: Insider brief Quantum science can be difficult to understand, that’s a fact. The terminology alone – qubits, superposition, quantum error correction, entanglement – can make the field feel inaccessible to anyone without a physics background. That is precisely what The Quantum Kid set out to change. Over the course of its first year, the podcast […]
